item.title: Tencent WeVisOne-VL Unifies Detection, OCR, Segmentation and Matting
item.description:
Tencent’s WeChat Vision team released WeVisOne-VL, an Apache 2.0 vision language model in 2B and 4B sizes. It handles detection, OCR, counting, segmentation and alpha matting in one model, with a 9.6M-parameter pixel decoder.

The post Tencent WeVisOne-VL Unifies Detection, OCR, Segmentation and Matting appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Anthropic Releases FlashProve: Cryptographic Proofs That a Reply Came From Committed Weights
item.description:
Anthropic released FlashProve, an Apache 2.0 zkSNARK prototype that proves a reply came from a committed model without revealing weights. It proves Llama 4 Maverick at 110 tokens/second on 1 H100, with 19 MB proofs.

The post Anthropic Releases FlashProve: Cryptographic Proofs That a Reply Came From Committed Weights appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: NVIDIA Shows 3 Ways to Speed Up MoE Inference on DGX Spark, Lifting Ling-3.0-flash Throughput 42.5%
item.description:
NVIDIA shows how 3 stacked optimizations speed up MoE inference on a single DGX Spark. On Ant Group inclusionAI's 124B Ling-3.0-flash, GSM8K decode throughput rose 42.5% with no detectable accuracy change.

The post NVIDIA Shows 3 Ways to Speed Up MoE Inference on DGX Spark, Lifting Ling-3.0-flash Throughput 42.5% appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Soniox STT v6 Adds Agent Text Input and Echo Filtering for Voice Agents
item.description:
Soniox has released Soniox STT v6, the latest generation of its speech-to-text API. Soniox STT v6 is a speech-to-text model that reads what a voice agent says while hearing the caller. It uses that text to recognize short replies and to drop the agent’s own voice. The release ships as stt-rt-v6 for streaming and stt-async-v6 […]

The post Soniox STT v6 Adds Agent Text Input and Echo Filtering for Voice Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80%
item.description:
OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend for its monorepo. It handles branches independently, reuses stored packfiles across fetches, cut median push latency by nearly 80%, and now delivers nearly a petabyte of Git data per day.

The post OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80% appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Zyphra AI Introduces Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA): A Path to True Subquadratic Attention
item.description:
Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA) is a tree-indexed sparse attention method that retrofits frozen LLMs with 4B tokens of distillation, matching dense attention on reasoning and 256K retrieval benchmarks.

The post Zyphra AI Introduces Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA): A Path to True Subquadratic Attention appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: The Letter Company Releases Letterpress-1: A Coding Agent Built for Growth Engineering
item.description:
Letter has released the beta of Letterpress-1, a coding agent, harness and IDE for growth engineering. It reads a git-based site and its market, then opens pull requests for SEO, GEO and conversion work.

The post The Letter Company Releases Letterpress-1: A Coding Agent Built for Growth Engineering appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Deep Principle Releases Hydrogen-1.0: A 753B Open-Weight Model for Scientific Discovery
item.description:
Deep Principle has released Hydrogen-1.0, an open-weight scientific model for chemistry, materials science and life sciences. It is built by post-training Z.ai’s GLM-5.3 on domain data, laboratory records and agent discovery trajectories. For developers, it offers open weights that report a FrontierScience-Research win over GPT-6-Astra. The weights ship under the MIT License. TL;DR What is […]

item.title: NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology: An Open Semantic Layer That Grounds AI Agent SQL
item.description:
NVIDIA released Auto Ontology, an Apache 2.0 library that generates a semantic layer from enterprise metadata. It grounds agent SQL in certified definitions and serves context through MCP, CLI and API.

The post NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology: An Open Semantic Layer That Grounds AI Agent SQL appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meet qwenGPU: Qwen3.5-2B With 45 Compiled GPU Layers That Run CUDA
item.description:
qwenGPU compiles a 4-lane SIMT GPU into Qwen3.5-2B as 45 untrained layers. The model writes every step of real CUDA launches itself, using Gated DeltaNet state as registers and memory.

The post Meet qwenGPU: Qwen3.5-2B With 45 Compiled GPU Layers That Run CUDA appeared first on MarkTechPost.
